\[
65+65=\boxed{130\text{ minutes}}.

\[
65+15=80\text{ minutes including the encore}.

\boxed{21\tfrac{2}{3}\text{ minutes for a usual concert}}

\text{Usual concert length}=\frac{65}{2}=32.5\text{ minutes}.
\]

\[
